processes.name: inference gateway
processes.description: A FastAPI service on GKE that receives inference requests from calling backends and forwards them to the model server.
processes.source_excerpt: our inference gateway, a FastAPI service on GKE
processes.notes: API keys are issued per calling team and have never been expired.

processes.name: model server
processes.description: The service that runs the actual model on GPU nodes, loads model artifacts at startup, and reads customer features.
processes.source_excerpt: the model server, which runs the actual model on GPU nodes
processes.notes: There is no authentication between the gateway and the model server. The model server uses its own service account to load artifacts. The description says artifact verification is not believed to occur.

data_stores.name: model registry bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket containing model artifacts loaded by the model server at startup.
data_stores.source_excerpt: model artifacts from a model registry bucket
data_stores.notes: The description says the bucket is trusted and does not identify verification that artifacts have not been swapped.

data_stores.name: Redis feature store
data_stores.description: A Redis store containing customer features including account age and spend bands per customer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a Redis feature store on the same network
data_stores.notes: Redis has no password and is only reachable inside the model network.

data_stores.name: inference log
data_stores.description: A BigQuery log containing every request and response, including raw prompts.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the gateway writes every request and response into an inference log in BigQuery
data_stores.notes: Raw prompts sometimes carry whatever the calling team's users typed.

data_flows.source_excerpt: The model server loads model artifacts from a model registry bucket at startup
data_flows.notes: The model server uses its own service account. The description says artifact integrity is trusted rather than verified.

data_flows.name: read features
data_flows.description: The model server reads customer features from the Redis feature store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the model server reads from a Redis feature store
data_flows.notes: Redis has no password; it is only reachable inside the model network.

data_flows.notes: The log contains raw prompts, which sometimes carry whatever the calling team's users typed.

trust_boundaries.name: system
trust_boundaries.description: The remainder of the hosted model inference system for which the description does not state a more specific zone.

assumptions.assumption: The inference gateway presents a web interface.
assumptions.basis: It is described as a FastAPI service, and FastAPI is a web application framework.

assumptions.assumption: The Redis feature store contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: Its stated contents include account age and spend bands per customer, which are customer-related personal features.
